$comment: Task 014-32c / L-19 — which query strategy can serve `pairs.active`, measured over every chain the coverage predicate admits. The vendor publishes NO per-chain listing route: /latest/dex/pairs/{chainId}, /token-pairs/v1/{chainId}, /latest/dex/chains/{chainId} and /latest/dex/chains all answer HTTP 404, and the promotion feeds carry no liquidity or volume. So every implementation is a query heuristic over one global relevance index, and the load-bearing fields here are `emptyUnionChains` — chains no candidate reaches, where the honest answer is a refusal rather than an empty page.
